notes: Spanish current-account statement, two pages, Verdana. Spanish number format (thousands ".", decimals ","). Furniture: bank name and branch line (top left, page 1), footer with registration line and "Página N de 2", running header on page 2. The customer address block is body text. Table 1 is a small key/value table (Titular, Cuenta, Divisa) set at the top right beside the bank name. Table 2 is a boxed summary panel; it stands BESIDE two paragraphs (read the panel first, then the paragraphs). Table 3 (movements) is a zebra table that CONTINUES on page 2 with its header repeated visually; it is one table with the header once. Each "Concepto" cell may hold two lines (operation, then detail in grey), given joined by one space; empty Cargo/Abono cells are "". The commission row has both amounts empty. The last row "Totales del período" spans the first three columns. "Información importante" lists three items with TYPED en dashes ("– ") and a hanging indent; the fourth key sentence is the text of the second dash item WITHOUT its dash.
